timing.estimator: median per diagram then geomean of head/base ratios
timing.order: alternate AB/BA by diagram index plus repetition plus block
timing.errors: fail whole experiment; preserve raw evidence; never drop a record

configuration.theme: renderer defaults plus original input directives
configuration.pele: native default font/wrap settings; no matching of v13 appearance
configuration.reset: AnalysisCache and text widths outside timing; configuration and loaded modules stay warm

backgroundLoad.measurementEnvironment: observed background activity; not an idle-host baseline
backgroundLoad.method: 60 consecutive 1000 ms process-snapshot intervals; nearest-rank p95 of total CPU delta; total limit is ceil(p95 * 1.20); the per-process field equals the total limit and imposes no additional cap

assignment.reason: Parser sinks and lazy AST access change architecture and public behavior.

candidates.deliveryScope: candidate Node fit only; integration and final browser comparison are separate
reasons: Node gain/flat-time byte reduction threshold failed

limitations: Untimed mechanism/output evidence; no acceptance/P12 or physical allocation verdict.

Counts executed object/array/regexp literals, new expressions, function/arrow expressions, object accessor/method function creation, rest parameter arrays and object-valued results of listed allocation-returning native calls in parser.ts/model.ts/result.ts/ast.ts only.
Counters reset after setup and cache reset before normal SVG render; no lazy metadata reads inside render count.
Native engine internal storage and implicit iterator/context allocations are excluded; new lazy closure function objects are counted and physical allocation separately measured by P7.
Unchanged lexer/preprocessing/render/API allocation sites excluded. Source-level counts do not estimate allocated bytes.
Forced metadata counts separately show the replay cost after rendering, and full prepared parse values compared using structuredClone + isDeepStrictEqual for all four variants.
Plain minified base/head and unminified instrumented base/head SVGs compared exactly; parser records never inferred from AST size.

declaredCondition.definition: Executed object/array/regexp literals, new expressions, arrow/function expressions, object accessor/method functions, rest arrays, and object-valued results of allocation-returning native calls in parser.ts/model.ts/result.ts/ast.ts. Includes new lazy result/captured preprocessing/closures/getter+setter functions; raw categories and site lists retained.
controls: All 5000 plain/instrumented base/head SVG outputs identical
All 5000 forced public parse results identical including model,diagnostics,AST,symbols,statements,tokens when requested
Direct parser remains eager; normal production renderer path used unchanged by benchmark
Captured replay context,freeze/seal,serialization,cache and resource/extension/ASCII/editor consumers preserved
declaredCondition.physicalAllocationCondition: Fresh base and head P7 diagnostic jobs, fixed 3 warmups/7 independent sampled-allocation children each over 5000 records; median head allocation estimate must be strictly below base. Recompute from saved profiles and calibration. Report uncertainty/exclusions; no inference of bytes from object counts.

requirementAmendments.status: proposed; pending Knut review before delivery

excludedFromCreationCount: Engine backing storage and implicit contexts/iterators
Physical bytes (measured separately by P7 sampling)

mechanism.method: Untimed instrumented executed operation counts; not physical allocation bytes. See preserved scripts for attribution.

allocationComparison.method: Existing P7 V8 sampling: median of seven independent child estimates under allocationRender; full 5000 records; reset/setup excluded
limitations: Sampled estimates, not exact allocation bytes; excludes native/external buffers and allocations outside renderer stacks.
Calibration error and replicate spread are empirical descriptions, not confidence bounds.
Base and head diagnostic jobs run serially as separate passes; this is not interleaved acceptance timing.
A lower allocation estimate does not override P12 timing/bytes or correctness requirements.

methods.measurerCalls: Actual width-method invocations, including any width-cache hits. Vertical metrics invocations are excluded and reported separately when supplied by the renderer.
methods.metricsCalls: Optional actual vertical-metrics method invocations; available for v13, absent for Pele.
methods.allocations: V8 HeapProfiler.startSampling with collected minor/major objects included; sum selfSize below named allocationRender frame; median independent child estimates. Timing artifacts avoid diagnostic-counter allocations.
methods.scavenge: Pinned --trace-gc-nvp pause= with gc=s, only between synchronous render markers. Other GC, setup/reset pauses and final forced-boundary pause reported separately.
methods.traceAllocation: Supplemental sum of V8 allocated= over GC intervals through final forced boundary; byte-precise occupancy deltas, NOT exact gross allocation.
methods.markup: UTF-8 Buffer.byteLength plus quote-aware XML start-tag and attribute counting.
methods.features: v13 preprocessing, parser/token model and actual label layout inspection; number of occurrences and number of diagrams containing each feature.
methods.stages: Diagnostic stage clock; layout includes nested measure and graphLayout. Unaccounted time = total minus parse/layout/serialise; instrumentation overhead remains.

allocationError.interpretation: Empirical calibration error and replicate spread, not a general confidence bound. Excludes native/external buffers and allocations outside sampled renderer stacks.
